مُصْعَرٌّ , (S,) in the K مُصْعَرٌ, said to be like مُكْرَمٌ, but the former is the right, as is shown by the ex. below, (TA,) applied to a night-journey to water, Hard, or severe. (S, K.) A poet says, “وَقَدْ قَرَبْنَ قَرَبًا مُصْعَرَّا
” [And they had performed a hard night-journey to water]. (S, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
